name: RfcHierarchyMutation

derive_role.standalone: RFC has no active parent and no active children
derive_role.master: RFC has no active parent and one or more active children
derive_role.subordinate: RFC has exactly one active parent
derive_role.rule: role is query-derived only; no mutable role field exists

validate_parent_child.transaction: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork after pure ID validation
checks: parent and child are distinct existing RFC identities
child has no different active parent
child has no active direct sr_rfc_links because direct SR links terminate only at roots
if both parent.customer_org_id and child.customer_org_id are known they are equal
unknown Customer on either side remains permitted but returns RFC_CUSTOMER_UNRESOLVED warning
provider/import evidence alone does not call this mutation path without an accepted reviewed hierarchy proposal
validate_parent_child.result: VALID, VALID_WITH_WARNING, or typed blocker; never guesses a hierarchy from identifier suffixes or source row proximity

steps: revalidate hierarchy constraints inside UnitOfWork
if exact active edge already exists return semantic NO_CHANGE receipt
allocate edge ID
insert receipt
insert active rfc_hierarchy_edges row
increment parent and child revisions
insert audit/result references
project exact RfcBranchV1 response inside the same UnitOfWork
commit

reparent_subordinate.risk: LLD-05 RfcHistoryRiskProvider owns complete history-risk evidence and freshness; HIGH requires reviewed correction, LOW does not, INDETERMINATE fails closed
steps: load exact old active edge and involved RFCs
revalidate supplied base revisions and exact old/new branch state
obtain current RfcHierarchyHistoryAuthorityV1 from LLD-05 using this writer UnitOfWork
if INDETERMINATE fail closed before receipt or mutation
reconstruct current SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_REVIEW_V1
if HIGH require supplied review_fingerprint and exact equality; if LOW allow null but exact-compare any supplied fingerprint
any review mismatch, including same LOW/HIGH with changed provider_fingerprint, returns TICKET_RELATIONSHIP_STALE
validate new parent-child pair and blockers
insert receipt
supersede old edge with closing provenance
insert new active edge
increment changed RFC revisions
audit old/new hierarchy identities, reason and the accepted review_fingerprint|null
project exact RfcBranchV1 response inside the same UnitOfWork
commit
rules: reparent preserves RFC identities and old edge history
reparent never changes WFM identity/ownership itself
reparent never copies inherited SR context into subordinate direct links
LLD-05 is read-only participant here and never creates a receipt, commits or rolls back

detach_subordinate.effect: child becomes a root/standalone unless it independently has children (which is impossible while it was subordinate)
steps: load exact current parent/active edge and revalidate supplied parent+child revisions
obtain current RfcHierarchyHistoryAuthorityV1 from LLD-05 using this writer UnitOfWork
if INDETERMINATE fail closed before receipt or mutation
reconstruct current SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_REVIEW_V1 with new_parent_rfc_id/new_branch_fingerprint null
if HIGH require supplied review_fingerprint and exact equality; if LOW allow null but exact-compare any supplied fingerprint
any review mismatch including changed history authority returns TICKET_RELATIONSHIP_STALE
insert receipt
supersede edge
increment parent/child revisions
audit accepted review_fingerprint|null
project exact RfcBranchV1 response inside the same UnitOfWork
commit
detach_subordinate.response_root: post-command child_rfc_id after it becomes parentless

database_defence: active-edge INSERT trigger rejects parent that is active child
active-edge INSERT trigger rejects child that is active parent
active-edge INSERT trigger rejects child with active direct SR links
known Customer mismatch trigger/command guard rejects active hierarchy creation; Customer correction command separately revalidates branch consistency
performance: all hierarchy validity checks are indexed point/EXISTS queries
no recursive traversal is required because accepted depth is exactly two
child lists use keyset pagination with no business child-count cap
complete-branch fingerprint computation may stream indexed active child authority rows in child rfc_id order but may not materialize an unbounded RfcDetail collection merely to hash it
LLD-05 history authority crosses the packet boundary only as bounded status/risk/count/fingerprint; provider may stream its own complete evidence authority

branch_fingerprint.purpose: Exact deterministic hierarchy-authority freshness token for RfcBranchV1. It is not a digest of unrelated display/source/history fields.

subordinates: for every active direct child: rfc_hierarchy_edge_id

branch_fingerprint.ordering: subordinate entries sort by child rfc_id UTF-8 bytes ascending; root is fixed and appears once
branch_fingerprint.canonicalization: Build the exact closed object {schema:'SOMA_RFC_BRANCH_FINGERPRINT_V1',root:{rfc_id,revision,customer_org_id,local_archive_state},subordinates:[{rfc_hierarchy_edge_id,rfc_id,revision,customer_org_id,local_archive_state},...]}; serialize with LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exactly (ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), UTF-8) after ordinary owning-field validation; no extra keys are permitted.
branch_fingerprint.digest: lowercase SHA-256 hex over the exact canonical UTF-8 bytes
exclusions: RfcDetailV1 source_projection and warnings because they are presentation/source state rather than hierarchy authority
Task/WFM/Objective history; reviewed correction freshness is separately bound by SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_REVIEW_V1
direct SR/device-reference counts because they do not own hierarchy state; command blockers are revalidated authoritatively inside the writer UoW
cursor/page boundaries and client page size
timestamps, audit ids, command ids, physical row order and generated presentation text
branch_fingerprint.mutation_rule: The command recomputes the complete branch fingerprint under the same writer UnitOfWork after the material hierarchy write, or over the current branch for semantic NO_CHANGE. Client-supplied fingerprints are never trusted as the resulting fingerprint.
branch_fingerprint.response_rule: Every hierarchy mutation returns RfcBranchV1 projected inside the same UnitOfWork after the final hierarchy state is known. Because mutation requests have no page-size input, their response uses the RFC children default page size 100. Exact command replay returns the persisted original RfcBranchV1 snapshot and never rebuilds it from later state.

golden_vectors.rule: Two-child vector proves child rfc_id ordering and null/archive participation.

hierarchy_review.purpose: Exact reviewed-correction freshness for reparent/detach. It composes current LLD-03 structural review facts with the complete bounded LLD-05 history authority so reviewed consequences cannot drift while hierarchy remains unchanged.
hierarchy_review.availability: Only when RfcHierarchyHistoryAuthorityV1.status=READY. INDETERMINATE produces no review fingerprint and cannot authorize mutation.
hierarchy_review.ordering: blockers use validate_parent_child closed validator order then code UTF-8; warnings use closed validator order then code UTF-8
hierarchy_review.canonicalization: Serialize the exact closed object with LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exactly (ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), UTF-8); no extra keys are permitted.
hierarchy_review.digest: lowercase SHA-256 hex over exact canonical UTF-8 bytes
hierarchy_review.command_rule: Writer reconstructs this object from current owner/provider authority before receipt/mutation. HIGH requires exact supplied review_fingerprint; LOW permits null, but if a fingerprint is supplied it must exactly match. Any structural, blocker/warning or LLD-05 provider fingerprint/count change invalidates the old review even if history_risk remains HIGH or LOW.
hierarchy_review.provider_boundary: Only risk/count/provider_fingerprint cross from LLD-05. No Task/WFM/Objective row, body, description or history list is copied into LLD-03 request, result or audit.

branch_cursor.last_key_tuple: array containing exactly the last returned child rfc_id UUID string
branch_cursor.filter_fingerprint_canonicalization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exact UTF-8 followed by lowercase SHA-256 hex
branch_cursor.query_page_rule: GetRfcBranch uses caller limit 1..500, default 100. Hierarchy mutation responses always use limit 100 and cursor input null.
branch_cursor.continuation_rule: continuation is null when no additional direct child exists after the returned page; otherwise it is the exact semantic CursorV1 body for the last returned child. LLD-12 may integrity-protect/opaquely encode that body for transport but may not alter its semantic fields.
